result:
I’d make it impossible to experience another person as less real than yourself.

Not forced kindness. Not universal agreement. Just the removal of that mental trick that turns someone across a border, a screen, or an argument into an abstraction.

The world would still have conflict, selfishness, and irreconcilable differences. But if everyone could feel—even briefly—the full weight of another person’s inner life, I think casual cruelty would become much harder to sustain.
